rule: Review D8 overflow against the ratified D1-D8 foundation. Name equality alone is not duplication; exact semantic duplication rejects a row. Clear distinct language-visible semantics may enter the D9 semantic inventory unplaced. Ambiguous or boundary-dependent rows remain HOLD rather than guessed.
